name: Lónya (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lónya: a crowned green shield with a white sword between two yellow lions, with a helm and red and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed LÓNYA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lónya arms with crown, helm, mantling and scroll
